staticLifecycleReview.method: Read-only inspection of current production code and existing regression cases.
staticLifecycleReview.focus: Could delayed profile, CV, workspace or application responses update the wrong workspace after switching, disconnecting or deleting cloud data?
staticLifecycleReview.result: No concrete defect identified in the reviewed paths; no code correction or repeated test suite was justified.
reviewedProtections: iPhone session/content generations and operation tickets reject obsolete data and authorization errors.
iPhone profile editor context binds saves to service origin and workspace; foreign CV metadata cannot silently select another workspace file.
Android action serialization, workspace-keyed private storage, connection identity, response sequence, save generation and cancellation fence state updates.
Application continuation requires fresh authenticated server eligibility; old continuation responses cannot become receipts for a new workspace.
Hosted revocation removes subsequent native access; deletion locks and conditional upload tombstones prevent delayed uploads from restoring deleted PDF contents.
Browser account reads and mutations use abort and generation checks, with deletion success requiring a confirmed service response.
staticLifecycleReview.retainedDraftMeaning: Private phone drafts can intentionally survive disconnect or cloud deletion. A carried draft still requires deliberate review/save; retaining it is not acceptance of a stale response or automatic transmission.
staticLifecycleReview.limitation: Static review and previously executed synthetic tests do not establish real-account native lifecycle or physical-phone acceptance.
